subject: The Spirit Temple
text: The Spirit Temple is divided into the West Wing and the East Wing, and requires both Young Link and Adult Link to finish.

evidence.quote:
The Spirit Temple is unique in that it is the only dungeon which requires both
Young Link and Adult Link to finish (with the possible exception of Dodongo's
Cavern, which contains a Skulltula only obtainable with Adult Link).  The
Temple is divided into two wings: The West Wing, and the East Wing.

subject: Giant blue block
text: At the top of the entrance stairs, pushing the giant blue block into the pit requires the Silver Gauntlets.

evidence.quote:
At the top of the stairs, go to the right to find a doorway blocked
by a giant blue block.  Run up to the block and grab hold of it, and now that
you have the Silver Gauntlets, you can push it forward.  Keep pushing it
forward until the block falls into a pit in the ground.

subject: Crystal Switch
text: Hitting the Crystal Switch on the ceiling in the entrance opens the doors on the left and right sides of the room.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the Beamos, and then nail the Crystal
Switch on the ceiling above to open the doors on the left and right sides of
the room.

subject: Silver Rupee
text: Reaching the Silver Rupee suspended above the floor in the Rolling Boulder Room requires running out to it using the Hover Boots.

evidence.quote:
None of the Silver Rupees are particularly hard to
find, but to reach the one suspended slightly above the floor you'll need to
run out to it using the Hover Boots.

subject: Rolling Boulder Room door
text: Collecting all five Silver Rupees in the Rolling Boulder Room unseals the door on the far side of the room.

evidence.quote:
All five of the Silver Rupees in the room will unseal the door on the
far side of the room.

subject: Rolling Boulder Room
text: Playing the Song of Time moves the Block of Time to reveal a Gold Skulltula behind its original position.

evidence.quote:
To get the Gold Skulltula in this room, play the Song of Time near the Block of
Time to transport the Block of Time into an adjacent alcove.  The Gold
Skulltula is behind the Block of Time's original position.

subject: Small Chest Room
text: Defeating the Like-Like that drops from the ceiling allows Link to open the chest containing a Small Key.

evidence.quote:
Step forward, and a
Like-Like will fall from the ceiling.  Kill the Like-Like, then open the chest
to get a Small Key.

subject: Spirit Temple Entrance
text: The unlocked door on the west side of the entrance leads into the Triforce/Compass Room.

evidence.quote:
Go through the door on the west side of the room, the one we didn't go through
last time we were here.  If that isn't specific enough for you, then it's the
door that's not locked and the door that we didn't just come through.

subject: Triforce/Compass Room
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Triforce symbol spawns a chest on the opposite ledge containing the Compass, reached with the Longshot.

evidence.quote:
step onto the Triforce symbol and play Zelda's
Lullaby.  A chest will appear on the opposite ledge.  Pull yourself over to it
with the Longshot, and open the chest to get the Compass.

subject: Spirit Temple Entrance
text: The locked door on the north side of the entrance leads toward the Lower Mirror Chamber.

evidence.quote:
Go through the locked door on the north side of the room, to your left as you
come out of the Triforce/Compass Room.

subject: Floor Master
text: In the mirror room, an invisible Floor Master can be killed with a Jump Attack, and its offspring defeated with Din's Fire.

evidence.quote:
Run around to the other side of the
mirror, where there is an invisible Floor Master.  Z-Target him (the lens is
optional) and use a Jump Attack to kill it one hit, then use Din's Fire to kill
it's offspring.

subject: Sun panels
text: Shining sunlight onto the third sun panel using the mirror unseals the western door.

evidence.quote:
Push it forward until the mirror shines
the light of the sun onto each of the sun panels in the room.  The first two
sun panels will make chests appear (the first contains a recovery heart, the
second a frost trap).  The third panel will unseal the door in the west of the
room.  The last panel will make a Wall Master appear and attempt to capture
you.

subject: The Colossus Chamber
text: Playing Zelda's Lullaby on the Colossus statue's left hand causes a chest with a Small Key to appear on the right hand.

evidence.quote:
Stand on the symbol on the left hand and play Zelda's Lullaby, and a chest will
appear on the opposite hand (the statue's right).  Re-equip the Kokiri Boots,
and use the Longshot to pull yourself over to the opposite hand.  Open the
chest to get a Small Key.

subject: Pierre
text: Playing the Scarecrow's Song where Navi flutters summons Pierre, allowing Link to Longshot across the pit.

evidence.quote:
At the top, look north, and Navi will flutter over to the other
side of the pit.  Play the Scarecrow's Song, and Pierre will appear on the
other side.  Pull yourself over to him with the Longshot.

subject: The Colossus Chamber
text: A Gold Skulltula is located behind Pierre across the pit in the Colossus Chamber, providing the one hundredth token.

evidence.quote:
Go around behind
Pierre to find another Gold Skulltula.  Kill it and take it's token.  Congratulations, that makes one hundred Skulltula Tokens.

subject: The Colossus Chamber
text: The locked door in the southeast corner of the Colossus Chamber leads to the next level of the temple.

evidence.quote:
Climb back up both flights of
stairs, and go through the locked door in the southeast corner.

subject: Anubis
text: Fire Arrows can be used to defeat the three Anubis easily in the Treble Anubis Room.

evidence.quote:
Young Link had to face one Anubis.  Adult Link gets to face three.  Use your
Fire Arrows to defeat them easily.

subject: Beamos statue
text: Bombing the Beamos statue on the north side of the Treble Anubis Room opens the door in the southeast.

evidence.quote:
Bomb the Beamos statue on the north side of
the room, and the door in the southeast of the room will open.  Go through it.

subject: Blue switch
text: Shooting an Armos with an arrow coaxes it into hopping onto the blue switch to open the sealed door on the south side of the room.

evidence.quote:
Directly in front of you as you enter is a blue switch, which opens the
sealed door on the south side of the room.  To open it, you have to coax one of
the Armos Knights surrounding the switch into stepping on it, and staying on it
long enough for you to go through the door before it seals itself again...Stand near
the sealed door, and shoot the Armos with an arrow.  It will come to life and
hop towards you.  When it steps on the switch, go through the door.

subject: Upper East Stairwell
text: The Upper East Stairwell contains two chests visible with the Lens of Truth that hold recovery hearts.

evidence.quote:
This room contains two chests, which contain lousy recovery hearts.  You can
use the Lens of Truth to see the chests, if you really need two recovery hearts
that badly.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: Repeatedly performing a Jump Attack followed by a backflip is an effective tactic against the Iron Knuckle as Adult Link.

evidence.quote:
A tactic that seems to work particularly well, but only works with Adult Link,
is to repeatedly perform a Jump Attack followed by a backflip, followed by a
Jump Attack, followed by a backflip, etc.

subject: East Iron Knuckle Room
text: Defeating the Iron Knuckle opens the door behind its throne leading into a tunnel.

evidence.quote:
Once the Iron Knuckle is dead, then the door behind it's throne will open.  Go
through it and through the tunnel on the other side.
